authority.source: owner ruling 2026-10-02 (wave 2026-10-02d row BV): three template categories - Templates, Kits, Community packs; a community pack is finished, installed and used at once and cannot be modified; the community makes and shares them; a shared pack passes automatic checks (validate, bench, no outside network calls) and a NoaCG admin's approval before anyone else sees it; NoaCG seeds the shelf first. Owner answers 2026-10-08 (wave 2026-10-08 row K): submit and Your packs on the wizard's Community packs shelf, never from Playout; a pack is a set of the maker's own graphics with no rundown required; the maker picks the name shown, never their real name or email; admin review on the shelf; updates never change installs; approved packs visible to everyone; the maker withdraws at once; the decision shows only as a status. Owner 2026-10-08 (wave row D): the D12 order stays, so updates (AC-11) and the community.publish check on submit come before submit opens to every maker
